# Public capabilities and environment coverage

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-capabilities.mjs from scripts/lib/capabilities.mjs; do not edit by hand. -->

This registry describes implemented public workflows. Availability is not runtime readiness or a security verdict. `doctor` performs static installation checks; it does not execute target code, Docker, or network requests.

| Capability | Release support | Public commands | Behavior and limits |
|---|---|---|---|
| source-review | AVAILABLE | `plan`, `next`, `ingest`, `ingest-batch`, `finalize`, `validate` | Sealed repository inventory, scoped review packets, validated result ingestion, and coverage accounting. An external reviewer supplies analysis. Completion and zero findings do not establish security clearance. |
| review-integration | AVAILABLE | `review-template`, `check-result` | Export an inert result template and validate a reviewer result against its sealed packet without ingesting it. Integration helpers do not perform semantic source analysis or run an analysis provider. |
| source-analysis-provider | UNAVAILABLE | None | Bundled automated semantic source-analysis provider. The reference byte consumer checks transport behavior; it does not analyze security. |
| source-pattern-checks | AVAILABLE_NARROW | `npm run audit:source-check`, `npm run evaluate:source-check` | Standalone passive JavaScript checks for two literal Node TLS configuration patterns, with source coordinates and repair guidance. Observations remain UNPROVEN; no target execution, automatic ingestion, semantic security verdict, TypeScript/JSX support, or independent quality validation. |
| status | AVAILABLE | `status` | Read saved progress, coverage gaps, failures, and interrupted attempts. Saved state is not evidence that a target remains unchanged. |
| reports | AVAILABLE | `report`, `compare` | Generate Markdown and SARIF reports and compare finding lineages. Disappearance is claimed-fixed or not-observed, never independently verified remediation. |
| repair-brief | AVAILABLE | `repair-brief` | Prepare evidence-linked repair and retest guidance from recorded findings. A brief does not patch a target, execute a retest, or verify a fix. |
| verdict-assessment | AVAILABLE | `verdict` | Explain the evidence supporting and limiting a recorded verdict. Descriptive assessment cannot promote provider claims into controller-authenticated semantic proof. |
| benchmark | AVAILABLE | `benchmark` | Evaluate recorded benchmark submissions against labeled cases and report coverage and accuracy limitations. Fixture tests and evaluator scores do not establish independent real-world detection accuracy. |
| readiness | AVAILABLE | `doctor`, `capabilities` | Inspect local installation prerequisites and publish this capability registry without target execution. Static checks do not inspect a Docker daemon, verify an image, or prove runtime readiness. |
| engagement-orchestration | AVAILABLE_NARROW | `engage run`, `engage resume`, `engage status`, `engage stop`, `engage work next`, `engage work status`, `engage work submit`, `engage work finalize`, `engage work validate` | Durable target-neutral engagement orchestration across applicable registered routes under one operator statement and shared ledger. Orchestration covers shipped registered routes. Declared tool or named host-adapter unavailability remains explicit; omitted immutable inputs or references require a successor engagement, and route evidence retains its own limits. |
| t1-proof | AVAILABLE_NARROW | `run-proof` | Sealed, network-denied repository proof through the fixed Docker worker route. Requires a compatible immutable Node/npm worker, sealed inputs, and the existing proof contract; no arbitrary runtime support. |
| t2-service-proof | AVAILABLE_NARROW | `run-service-proof` | One foreground Node/npm service with loopback probes in separate isolated sessions and verified cleanup. Lifecycle evidence remains UNPROVEN without a controller-authenticated semantic oracle. Browser and multi-service/database stacks are unsupported. |
| https-recon | AVAILABLE_NARROW | `http-recon go` | One bounded HTTPS reconnaissance action through its existing public controller. A URL entry point is not a comprehensive website assessment. |
| authenticated-http | AVAILABLE_NARROW | `http-authed campaign-attested`, `http-authed campaign-stop` | Adaptive sealed authenticated HTTP discovery and actions through the durable campaign controller. Every request remains bound to the campaign authority, scope policy, action limits, retained receipt, and stop/cleanup state. |
| ghidra-static-reverse | AVAILABLE_NARROW | `last-aperture-reverse ghidra analyze` | Fixed Ghidra headless static export for one copied native artifact with bounded function, network API/reference/call-site, sanitized static endpoint, and authentication-hint metadata. Native launchers run directly; Windows .bat and .cmd launchers require javac.exe and jar.exe and run through the bundled fixed compatibility agent and Job Object bridge. Static observations do not execute the target or establish program semantics. |
| frida-local-reverse | AVAILABLE_NARROW | `last-aperture-reverse frida trace` | Fixed Frida local spawn and enter/leave trace for one exact module and symbol, with an opaque module-relative symbol offset. This v1 host process route is not a sandbox and records no arguments, return values, memory, or protocol values. |
| frida-typed-reverse | AVAILABLE_NARROW | `last-aperture-reverse frida trace-plan` | Typed multi-hook Frida call tracing for bounded local spawn, local PID/name attach, USB PID/name/application attach, and explicit-device attach plans. Only the bundled typed-capture agent and exact plan selectors are accepted. Declared raw captures can contain sensitive values. Attach evidence remains PARTIAL because a supplied local artifact copy cannot prove the attached runtime loaded identical bytes. |
| web-protocol-reconstruction | AVAILABLE_NARROW | `last-aperture-reverse web import-live-metadata`, `last-aperture-reverse web import-har`, `last-aperture-reverse web import-burp`, `last-aperture-reverse protocol build`, `last-aperture-reverse protocol generate`, `last-aperture-reverse protocol verify` | Import verified Last Aperture recon and settled sealed-plan auth metadata, an authorized HAR, or Burp HTTP-items XML offline; compile bounded observed protocol shapes; and generate a deterministic contract-bound Node connector. Live-metadata projection retains no values and does not claim complete endpoint/auth coverage, response-discovered locators, response shape, redirects, writes, replay, or pagination. Generation and verification perform no network I/O. The generated runtime is labeled GENERATED_REVIEWABLE, remains limited to its validated observed contract, and requires the externally retained manifest digest. |
| burp-proxy-history-export | AVAILABLE_NARROW | `integrations/burp-montoya/build.ps1` | Optional Community-compatible Montoya extension that exports deterministic value-free HAR from existing Burp Proxy history under one exact origin, path prefix, reviewed route-literal set, and item limit. Requires a caller-supplied local Montoya API JAR, JDK 17 through 21, and Burp. It reads existing history only; Scanner, network dispatch, and traffic modification are disabled. |
| semantic-oracle | UNAVAILABLE | None | Controller-authenticated semantic vulnerability and remediation verdicts. Process exit differences and cleanup receipts alone cannot establish a vulnerability or a verified fix. |
| browser-execution | AVAILABLE_NARROW | `http-authed campaign-attested` | Selected-tab authenticated request execution through the active browser companion bridge, with an optional declarative Web Storage session-to-header adapter. The bridge executes authorized actions in the selected tab and does not automate navigation or login. The optional adapter accepts one exact storage source and request-header carrier; its value stays inside the isolated dispatch. |
| database-stack-execution | UNAVAILABLE | None | Database-backed and multi-service application execution. Retained conformance kernels are not public target execution capabilities. |
| multi-runtime-execution | UNAVAILABLE | None | Generic proof-worker execution for Python, JVM, .NET, Go, Rust, and native targets beyond the fixed Frida routes. A language detected in source does not imply a compatible public proof worker. |
| deployed-evidence-acquisition | UNAVAILABLE | None | Acquire and trust current deployment or cloud runtime evidence. Repository deployment configuration does not establish what is running. Public evidence-import and acquisition transports remain unavailable. |
| generic-live | UNAVAILABLE | None | Unbounded or arbitrary autonomous live assessment, bounty, and out-of-band execution. Only the specific implemented public routes listed above are available. |
| remote-provider-and-publication | UNAVAILABLE | None | Public provider execution, remote gateways, and transparency publication. Retained command names fail closed pending their required trusted runtime identities. |
